html:
Currently, tourists are looking to learn and explore the beauty of Vietnamese craft villages, but do not know which craft village to visit, so follow Vietlook to explore the beauty of the Vietnamese countryside. The most beautiful is Quang Phu Cau Incense Village, however, many of you will wonder where is Quang Phu Cau Incense Village, so let’s refer to this article.

Quang Phu Cau Incense Village, a virtual living spot on the outskirts of Hanoi, is being sought out by many tourists, especially those who like to live virtually or explore the peaceful and rustic Vietnamese countryside, away from the hustle and bustle.

Located about 35 km south of Hanoi city center, visitors will visit the beauty of a traditional craft village, Quang Phu Cau incense village. To get here, visitors can choose a bus from Yen Nghia bus station, visitors can take bus 91, or drive themselves along National Highway 21B or Provincial Road 429.

The incense village has been preserved by the people of Quang Phu for many generations, and has been passed down for many generations, from sister to sister, mother to children…

Currently, incense is an indispensable product in every family, and is an attractive destination for tourists to visit. The incense village develops not only as a tourist attraction but also as a source of income for the people here.

Quang Phu Cau incense village operates almost all year round, very bustling with the decoration that is constantly changed according to each season, and this is also a place for visitors to take beautiful pictures.

There are very eye-catching display areas, visitors can take beautiful photos and freely pose to take beautiful photos.

Traveling to Quang Phu Cau incense stick craft village, almost every season, visitors can take beautiful photos, with incense bundles arranged very eye-catchingly, looking from afar like flowers or funny letters.

It can be said that Quang Phu Cau incense stick craft village is not only famous for its aesthetics and uniqueness, but also for its craftsmanship of a traditional village.

In addition, when visiting the incense stick craft village, visitors can also visit the process of making incense bundles, from simple manual work to meticulous finished products.

The incense bundles are arranged with their heads together at the base like blooming flowers with a variety of colors such as red, yellow, pink, blue … looking very eye-catching. Currently, photographers and tourists come here to hunt for photos.

Throughout the village, visitors will also see incense yards drying bundles of green, red, yellow, purple, pink incense… that look like flowers. Visitors will want to take beautiful pictures of themselves, next to a traditional craft village.

Quang Phu Cau incense village is one of the traditional craft villages that has been promoted and preserved to this day, not only bringing income to the people but also being a tourist development point.

In addition, the development of Quang Phu Cau incense village also creates many jobs for workers, and attracts tourists to visit, check in and learn about Vietnamese village culture.

If you are planning to travel to Hanoi, and want to learn about craft villages but do not know which traditional craft villages to visit, and if you visit Quang Phu Cau incense village, where is the address to visit and take beautiful souvenir photos.

When visiting Quang Phu Cau incense village, take a walk around the village, to see with your own eyes the work of the people here through each stage of processing until bringing out aromatic products.

Until today, although Quang Phu Cau incense village has been mixed with modern features, the traditional culture has been mixed to exude the unique beauty of a village, a traditional craft village of Vietnam. If you want to fully explore the beauty, rent a bicycle and cycle around the ancient village in the suburbs of Hanoi to feel its unique beauty.
